title: Monitoring
description: Real-time health of every container the Ploydok platform is supervising. Streams live over SSE and refreshes every five seconds.
orgDescription: Real-time health of application and database runtimes in this workspace.
fleetEmptyHint: The agent will start reporting containers here as soon as services are deployed and running.
noResourcesHint: The agent will report application and database runtimes here as soon as services are deployed and running.
noMatchHint: Try relaxing the filters or clearing the search.
collectingHint: Wait a few seconds for data to appear.

host.title: Host health
host.unavailable: Agent unreachable: host monitoring requires the Rust agent to be running.
host.reclaimedBalloon: The hypervisor reclaimed {{reclaimed}} through memory ballooning.

adminDisk.title: Disk usage
adminDisk.description: Disk usage and Docker cleanup for the entire instance, across all workspaces. These actions require an instance administrator.
adminDisk.cleanupConfirmDescription: This removes stopped containers, unused images, caches and unused networks. Volumes and running workloads are not removed.

kpi.title: Disk indicators
kpi.reclaimableHint: Unused exclusive image layers and non-shared build cache. Volumes are excluded.
kpi.growthHint: Compared with the measurement about 7 days ago.
kpi.needsWeek: Available after 7 days of measurements on the same disk capacity.
kpi.runwayHint: Estimate based on the observed 7-day growth rate.
kpi.notGrowing: Disk usage is stable or decreasing over the observed period.
kpi.inodesHint: File-system entries in use. They can run out before disk space does.
kpi.topPending: Individual resource measurements are not available yet.
kpi.noCleanup: No successful cleanup with a recorded gain yet.
kpi.historyFailed: Disk history could not be loaded.
kpi.historyHint: One host measurement per hour. Gaps indicate missing measurements.
kpi.collecting_one: Collecting history: {{count}} measurement. The chart appears after the next hourly measurement.
kpi.collecting_other: Collecting history: {{count}} measurements. The chart appears once two measurements are available.
kpi.topHint: Volumes, writable container layers, exclusive image layers and non-shared build cache. Sizes are not added together.
kpi.measurementMissingHint: The detailed measurement has not been received yet.
kpi.noConsumers: No resources with measured disk usage.

advisories.title: Security advisories
advisories.description: Ploydok sends dependency names and versions to OSV.dev during scans. Source code, secrets and user identifiers are not sent.
